title: Tensor with an integer power or dual of a rank-one line is exact and additive.
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, let $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ be its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $R$ be any sheaf of commutative rings on this site. Work in the category $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ of sheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with universes as in the pro-etale site convention. Let $L$ be a locally free rank-one $R$-module sheaf, meaning that locally for this topology $L$ is isomorphic to $R$. Using the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and internal sheaf Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom], define
$$
 L^{(m)}=\begin{cases}
 R,&m=0,\\
 L^{\otimes_R m},&m>0,\\
 \mathcal Hom_R(L^{\otimes_R(-m)},R),&m<0.
 \end{cases}
$$
For every integer $m$, let $T_m:\operatorname{Mod}(R)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ be $M\mapsto M\otimes_R L^{(m)}$, acting on a morphism $f$ by $f\otimes 1$. Then $T_m$ is additive, i.e. $T_m(f+g)=T_m(f)+T_m(g)$ for parallel morphisms, and it preserves finite limits and finite colimits [def-galois-finite-limits-colimits]. Thus this is the conjunction of additivity, preservation of finite limits, and preservation of finite colimits for the ordinary sheaf tensor functor, for every $m\in\mathbf Z$.

proof.text: Apply isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_iff_exists_over_iso_free to L at rank one. Its free sheaf on ULift (Fin 1) is the unit by freeUniqueIso, yielding the covering charts required by the signed-line flatness theorem.

Apply signed_line_power_flat [lem-pur-signed-line-power-flat] to those charts and the integer m. By integer cases, its signedLinePower is exactly coefficientTwistLine: both use scalarTensorPower at nonnegative degrees and its internal dual at negative degrees. Thus the tensor functor preserves finite limits and finite colimits.

Preservation of finite colimits implies additivity between these abelian categories by Mathlib CategoryTheory.rightExactFunctor_le_additiveFunctor. Combine this with the two finite preservation clauses.
